title: Add unit tests for gatsby-node.js slug generation
description: The gatsby-node.js file has critical logic for generating page slugs from markdown files. Test: 1) slug generation from relativePath, 2) permalink override behavior, 3) default layout fallback, 4) error handling for malformed frontmatter

title: Add validation tests for projectData structure
description: The projectData array (src/styles/projectData.ts) drives the entire projects page. Test: 1) all required fields present for each project, 2) pictureNr values are valid (0-9), 3) external URLs are well-formed, 4) vimeoId format validation, 5) no duplicate titles

title: Add unit tests for ProjectImages component image mapping
description: The ProjectImages component (src/components/ProjectImages.tsx) maps pictureNr prop to specific images from GraphQL. Test: 1) correct image returned for each pictureNr (0-9), 2) aspect ratio calculation logic, 3) out-of-bounds pictureNr handling, 4) GraphQL data structure validation

title: Add unit tests for Clock component time calculation logic
description: The Clock component (src/components/Clock.tsx) has complex angle calculation logic in componentDidMount() that converts hours/minutes/seconds to degrees. This needs unit tests to verify: 1) correct angle calculations for various times, 2) initial state angles, 3) edge cases like midnight/noon

title: Add unit tests for word animation logic in IndexPage
description: The IndexPage component (src/pages/index.tsx) has complex state management for animating words. Test: 1) word cycling through interests array, 2) character-by-character erasure and building, 3) interval/timeout cleanup, 4) edge cases when component unmounts during animation

title: Setup test infrastructure (Jest + React Testing Library)
description: Before writing tests, need to setup testing framework. Install and configure: 1) Jest, 2) React Testing Library, 3) Testing utilities for Gatsby, 4) Mock GraphQL queries, 5) Setup test scripts in package.json

title: Add integration tests for Projects page rendering
description: The projects.tsx page (src/pages/projects.tsx) renders projectData. Test: 1) all projects render correctly, 2) video vs image conditional rendering, 3) external links render when present, 4) responsive behavior, 5) contributions list rendering
